headline: Yearly prices up 13% to 20% on Grow and Advanced
what: Shopify's pricing page now shows pay-yearly prices of $89/mo for Grow (was $79) and $359/mo for Advanced (was $299). Pay-monthly prices are unchanged at $105 and $399, and Basic is unchanged at $29 yearly / $39 monthly. That cuts the annual-billing discount from about 25% to about 15% on Grow and about 10% on Advanced, and raises a year of Grow from $948 to $1,068 and a year of Advanced from $3,588 to $4,308.
who: Shopify merchants on Grow or Advanced who pay yearly or are about to renew or sign up on annual billing
seo_title: Shopify raised annual prices: Grow now $89/mo, Advanced $359/mo (pricing update)
seo_desc: Shopify's pay-yearly prices rose to $89/mo for Grow (from $79) and $359/mo for Advanced (from $299). Monthly prices are unchanged, so the annual discount shrank to roughly 10-15%.

headline: Enterprise+ now has a public price: $45 per user
what: Slack's pricing page used to say "Contact sales for pricing" for Enterprise+. It now lists $45 USD per user per month when paying annually, with the Contact Sales button still shown.
who: Organizations evaluating or negotiating Slack Enterprise+ plans
seo_title: Slack Enterprise+ price is now public: $45 per user per month (annual)
seo_desc: Slack's pricing page now lists Enterprise+ at $45 per user per month billed annually, replacing the old 'Contact sales for pricing' line.

headline: Claude Enterprise now lists a 20-seat minimum
what: The Enterprise plan on Anthropic's pricing page still reads US$20/seat/month billed annually plus usage at API rates, but now adds "20 seat minimum." That implies at least $4,800 a year in seat fees before any usage.
who: Small companies and teams considering Claude Enterprise instead of the Team plan
seo_title: Claude Enterprise now requires 20 seats minimum (Anthropic pricing update)
seo_desc: Anthropic's pricing page now says Claude Enterprise is US$20/seat/month billed annually with a 20 seat minimum, plus usage at API rates.

headline: New Figma Specs beta added to paid seats
what: Figma's pricing page adds Figma Specs, a beta for writing structured specs on the canvas, available on paid seats. Full, Dev, and Collab seat descriptions now all include Figma Specs, and Full seats now explicitly list Figma Motion. Figma Make also gains secrets management and a scaffolded Payload backend (database, APIs, auth, admin panel).
who: Figma customers on paid Full, Dev, or Collab seats

headline: Annual plans: cancellation now effective next billing cycle
what: Audible's plan page now says its annual Premium plans ($149.50/yr for 12 credits, $229.50/yr for 24 credits) can be canceled anytime "effective next billing cycle," where it previously just said "Cancel anytime." The "Save 16%" labels on the annual plans were also removed. Prices did not change.
who: Audible members on, or considering, annual Premium plans
